characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy unit performs any of the following actions, it suffers 2D6 hits with Strength 4, Armour Penetration 1, and Unmodifiable:
  • The enemy unit successfully Charges a unit containing It’s a Trap! in contact with a Terrain Feature.
  • The enemy unit comes into contact (while it was not in contact earlier) with a Terrain Feature that is in contact with a unit containing It’s a Trap!. Resolve the hits at the end of the action that triggered them. No unit can be affected by It’s a Trap! more than once in each Player Turn (including from different units containing It’s a Trap!).
